Treat stomachaches
Diarrhea, nausea, vomiting; hepatoxicity. Not recommended
for use.
Butterbur
Petasites spp.
Treat GI disorders and GI-related pain
Abdominal pain or pressure, sustained constipation,
discoloration of stool, dysphagia, severe nausea, vomiting.
Use with anticholinergics not advisable.
